description: Parkings à vélo - CC Romorantinais et Monestois - données OSM is a dataset listed in CC Romorantinais et Monestois open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Huwise. Ce jeu de données géolocalise les parkings à vélo en France. Les champs de ce jeu de données respectent le schéma des stationnements cyclables du référentiel des données publiques de schema.data.gouv.fr. Il se base sur les données OpenStreetMap, qui sont ensuite compilées et traitées par Opendatasoft. Coverage: Romorantinais et Monestois (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Territory. Its keywords are openstreetmap, osm, vélo, parking, transport, france. The portal shows 586 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-ccrm41-centrevaldeloire-portal.
